A '''quad-helix prismatic crystal''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. They were fitted into [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuators]] to generate [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blasts. The structure of the crystal eroded with every shot fired, and crystals were generally replaced after 45,000 shots. [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] used quad-helix prismatic crystals in their [[KX9 laser cannon/Legends|KX9 laser cannons]], which were used on [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWS" />
